reasons.police_report_adequate: The report omits the loss date and is only two short lines, so it is unlikely to be dated and detailed enough.
reasons.claim_status: Forced entry to a locked boot is plausible but under-documented, so the conservative posture favors requesting the receipt, a timestamped damage photo, and a corrected police report before any payment or refusal.
reasons.evidence_reliability: Only a serial number and an untampered-looking but untimed lock photo support the claim, while the receipt, CCTV, report details, and witness corroboration are missing or unreliable.
